behavior: global limited-item reservation reconciliation across persisted ownership scopes
summary: Items aggregates explicit owner-scoped and world-scoped limited quantities across inventory, equipment, bank, trade, portable containers, active corpses, and world-held records. Conflicting limits, unresolved reservation owners, malformed limits, and over-limit states are rejected without deleting or relocating items.
safe_fallback: Fail closed and preserve all persisted instances when a reservation owner or excess-item disposition is ambiguous.
runtime_impact: Prevents duplicate limited-item reservations from being accepted after restart, import, recovery, or cross-save coordination.
character_save_impact: Validates owner-scoped aggregate quantities without mutating Character state.
world_state_impact: Validates world-scoped aggregate quantities across every persisted item location.
native_dependencies: native limited and unique flag mappings
native account, party, guild, and world scope rules
native duplicate cleanup or item-selection priority
